description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for managing packed references (`packed-refs`) in a Git backend. It includes function declarations for initializing ref stores, locking and unlocking the packed-refs file, obtaining its size, and checking if a transaction is needed.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes a packed reference store for a given repository, returning a pointer to the ref_store.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing; returns 0 on success.

methods.name: packed_refs_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the packed-refs file previously locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the packed-refs file or 0 if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines whether a ref transaction needs to be executed on the specified packed-ref store.
